name: auto-dl-loop
description: An adversarial two-machine research task: a worker builds the deliverable, a validator judges it against a benchmark that only grows.

worker.description: The machine that researches and builds, round after round, and submits to the validator.
next: Set up the validator machine first. Its setup's configure step on this machine connects to the validator and fetches task.md; then setup has you choose the loop this project runs (normally research-iteration) and its values.

validator.description: The machine that reviews each submission against the benchmark and the hidden tests, and publishes the result.
next: Its setup's configure step on this machine settles task.md, the benchmark, the validation terms and the service; then setup has you choose the loop that reviews each submission (normally submission-review). Start the service the hand-off names afterwards.
